in_hebrew.name: Sanja
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Sanja הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Slavic word ‘sanjati’ which means ‘healer’ or ‘helper’. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with St. John the Baptist, who was known as the ‘voice of one crying in the wilderness’ and a precursor to Jesus. Sanja embodies the traits of compassion, strength, and selflessness.
